LanguageData.PS_AlertPathFooter: The cards return on their own while the colonist meditates - or click this alert to open the pick right now.
LanguageData.PS_AlertPathHeader: These colonists have enlightenment cards waiting to be faced:
LanguageData.PS_CardChooseLaterTip: Set the cards aside without choosing. They return while this colonist meditates - or reopen them anytime from the "Psycast path awaits" alert.
LanguageData.PS_CardRedealTip: Throw this hand back and deal a new one, right now. You get one reroll per awakening.
LanguageData.PS_LetterWaveText: The Ancient Psycaster Order has come to test the pilgrim. {0} of them assault from the edge of the map.
LanguageData.PS_MsgCardsAside: {0} set the cards aside for now - they return during meditation, or via the alert.
LanguageData.PS_MsgDeferReroll: {0} sets the cards aside to meditate further - the omens will shift.
LanguageData.PS_MsgForgo: {0} forwent the vision for deeper insight. (+{1} specialization points)
LanguageData.PS_MsgPilgrimReform: {0} has completed the pilgrimage and broken through. Reform a caravan at the site to bring them home.
LanguageData.PS_SetBreakChanceTip: Rolled once an hour for a meditating psycaster who has not yet reached Illuminated. Meditating for hours without a break pushes it higher. Set it to 0 and they never break through at all.
LanguageData.PS_SetBreakChanceTrans: Breakthrough chance each hour past Illuminated: {0}%
LanguageData.PS_SetBreakChanceTransTip: The same roll once a psycaster has climbed past Illuminated. Set it apart from the one above to make late game breakthroughs rarer or more common than the climb to get there. 0 stops them completely.
LanguageData.PS_SetCardRedeal: Allow one reroll at a first awakening
LanguageData.PS_SetFogNext: Still show the ones you can pick next
LanguageData.PS_SetFogNextTip: Psycasts you already meet the requirements for stay visible, so your next choice is always in front of you. Only what sits deeper up the tree is hidden.
LanguageData.PS_SetLinksTip: Psycasts in the same tree are linked. Levelling one adds a little to the ones it feeds, and the skill card shows you which.
LanguageData.PS_SetSafeWindowOff: Safe meditation: all day, meditating is never risky
